column1: # 声学测量参数表：加一个参数 = 加一行。
# 出处与设计说明见 measures.py 的模块 docstring；参考 chengafni/praat 的
# 每一节自己的表头行就是列名，列之间是**制表符**。
#       分析设置。派生命令里的 {key} 会被替换成 value；模型可以用同名工具参数
#       覆盖，被 min/max 卡住的是「明显写错的值」，不是正常范围。
#       从 Sound（或另一个派生对象，按依赖顺序排在前面）生成中间对象。
#       一行 = 一个参数。source 是 sound、某个派生 key，或用 + 连起来的两个对象
#       （pointProcess+sound 会先 selectObject 再 plusObject）。command 是 Praat
#       查询命令；用分号分隔多句，最后必须给 value 赋值。命令里出现 tmin/tmax
#       时才算「按时间段查询」，这时候 measure 的 from/to（含编辑器圈选）才生效。
#       要好几步（滤波、相减、相除）的参数交给已有的专用工具，不在这里重写一遍。
#       只能在编辑器里查的参数：measure 会用中文说明，而不是让 Praat 弹英文错误框。

column6: median = Get quantile: tmin, tmax, 0.5, "Hertz"; firstFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmin; lastFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmax; nFrames = Get number of frames; firstFrame = round (firstFrameTime); lastFrame = round (lastFrameTime); if firstFrame < 1; firstFrame = 1; endif; if lastFrame > nFrames; lastFrame = nFrames; endif; if lastFrame < 1; lastFrame = 1; endif; firstCenter = Get time from frame number: firstFrame; lastCenter = Get time from frame number: lastFrame; if firstCenter < tmin; firstFrame = firstFrame + 1; endif; if lastCenter > tmax; lastFrame = lastFrame - 1; endif; value = undefined; if median <> undefined; ceilingValue = median * 1.5; floorValue = median * 0.5; totalValue = 0; countValue = 0; for pitchFrame from firstFrame to lastFrame; f = Get value in frame: pitchFrame, "Hertz"; if f <> undefined and f >= floorValue and f <= ceilingValue; totalValue = totalValue + f; countValue = countValue + 1; endif; endfor; if countValue > 0; value = totalValue / countValue; endif; endif
column7: 整段（或圈选段）的平均基频；和最高/最低基频用同一批限幅帧（中位数的 0.5–1.5 倍）与同一批区间内帧中心；没有可信帧时不给值

column6: median = Get quantile: tmin, tmax, 0.5, "Hertz"; firstFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmin; lastFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmax; nFrames = Get number of frames; firstFrame = round (firstFrameTime); lastFrame = round (lastFrameTime); if firstFrame < 1; firstFrame = 1; endif; if lastFrame > nFrames; lastFrame = nFrames; endif; if lastFrame < 1; lastFrame = 1; endif; firstCenter = Get time from frame number: firstFrame; lastCenter = Get time from frame number: lastFrame; if firstCenter < tmin; firstFrame = firstFrame + 1; endif; if lastCenter > tmax; lastFrame = lastFrame - 1; endif; value = undefined; if median <> undefined; ceilingValue = median * 1.5; floorValue = median * 0.5; lowest = 0; for pitchFrame from firstFrame to lastFrame; f = Get value in frame: pitchFrame, "Hertz"; if f <> undefined and f >= floorValue and f <= ceilingValue; if lowest = 0 or f < lowest; lowest = f; endif; endif; endfor; if lowest > 0; value = lowest; endif; endif
column7: 稳取：逐帧找最低，只用中位数的 0.5–1.5 倍之间的帧（倍频、次谐波误判一起排除），且只用区间内帧中心；没有可信帧时不给值

column6: median = Get quantile: tmin, tmax, 0.5, "Hertz"; firstFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmin; lastFrameTime = Get frame number from time: tmax; nFrames = Get number of frames; firstFrame = round (firstFrameTime); lastFrame = round (lastFrameTime); if firstFrame < 1; firstFrame = 1; endif; if lastFrame > nFrames; lastFrame = nFrames; endif; if lastFrame < 1; lastFrame = 1; endif; firstCenter = Get time from frame number: firstFrame; lastCenter = Get time from frame number: lastFrame; if firstCenter < tmin; firstFrame = firstFrame + 1; endif; if lastCenter > tmax; lastFrame = lastFrame - 1; endif; value = undefined; if median <> undefined; ceilingValue = median * 1.5; floorValue = median * 0.5; highest = 0; for pitchFrame from firstFrame to lastFrame; f = Get value in frame: pitchFrame, "Hertz"; if f <> undefined and f >= floorValue and f <= ceilingValue; if f > highest; highest = f; endif; endif; endfor; if highest > 0; value = highest; endif; endif
column7: 稳取：逐帧找最高，同样只用中位数的 0.5–1.5 倍之间的区间内帧中心帧；没有可信帧时不给值

column6: value = Get value at time: tmin, "Hertz", "Linear"; step = Get time step; if step <= 0; step = (tmax - tmin) / 100; endif; t = tmin; while value = undefined and t < tmax; t = t + step; value = Get value at time: t, "Hertz", "Linear"; endwhile
column7: 参考 pitch_time.praat：起点测不到（清音/无声）就往后找第一个有声帧

column6: value = Get value at time: tmax, "Hertz", "Linear"; step = Get time step; if step <= 0; step = (tmax - tmin) / 100; endif; t = tmax; while value = undefined and t > tmin; t = t - step; value = Get value at time: t, "Hertz", "Linear"; endwhile
